turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text: That's a really interesting observation! It's true, relief can be a powerful, almost visceral emotion. Think about finishing a grueling exam, or finally submitting a major project—that feeling of release can be so intense that it manifests in a burst of expression, and sometimes that includes colorful language. It’s a way of physically releasing pent-up tension, really.
